title: ATHAAR: A Medieval Scientific Arabic Manuscript Dataset for Handwritten Text Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.08091v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite recent progress in handwritten text recognition, medieval Arabic scientific manuscripts remain an open challenge for current vision-language models (VLMs) due to cursive ligatures, variable diacritization, and more importantly the lack of training data. This paper aims to address this gap, by proposing the first annotation guidelines dedicated to the transcription of scientific Arabic manuscripts inspired by textual criticism, a well-established approach to historical text editing. We then propose, ATHAAR, a new dataset manually annotated following this guideline. Unlike previous resources in the field, ATHAAR varies both witnesses of the same text, calligraphic styles, and content to deal with texts but also numerals. Relying on state-of-the-art VLMs, we finally design a set of experiments to study models transfer across scripts, chapters, and treatises. translated_title: ATHAAR：用于手写文本识别的中世纪阿拉伯科学手稿数据集
translated_abstract: 尽管手写文本识别近来取得了进展，但由于草书连笔字形、变音符号标注的多变性，以及更重要的是训练数据的匮乏，中世纪阿拉伯科学手稿对当前的视觉-语言模型而言仍是一个悬而未决的挑战。本文旨在弥补这一空白，受校勘学——一种成熟的历史文本编辑方法——的启发，提出了首个专门面向科学阿拉伯手稿转录的标注准则。随后，我们提出了依照该准则进行人工标注的新数据集 ATHAAR。与该领域以往的资源不同，ATHAAR 在同一文本的不同抄本、书法风格以及内容上均具有多样性，既涵盖文本也涵盖数字。最后，我们基于最先进的视觉-语言模型设计了一系列实验，研究模型在不同文字、章节和论著之间的迁移能力。我们的研究发现凸显了当前系统在面对（此类手稿）时的局限性。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个受校勘学启发的科学阿拉伯手稿转录标注准则，并据此构建了首个涵盖多样抄本、书法风格与内容（含数字）的人工标注数据集 ATHAAR，用以推动中世纪阿拉伯科学手稿的手写文本识别研究。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the first textual-criticism-inspired annotation guidelines for transcribing scientific Arabic manuscripts and introduces ATHAAR, a new diverse manually annotated dataset that advances handwritten text recognition for medieval Arabic scientific manuscripts.
